listing_info.listing_name: Watch the "Bear Pass" in Downtown Gatlinburg!
Firefly Retreat
listing_info.description:
This 3 bedroom house lies on a large lot that overlooks the Roaring Fork Creek and has a view of the Gatlinburg Sky Lift. The house is 0.9 miles from the Aquarium, which puts you very close to downtown Gatlinburg and all it has to offer. If you don't want to walk, then there is a trolley stop a short distance from the house. The house is also located 4 miles from the Rocky Top Sports World. As an added bonus there are no curvy, hilly roads to worry about because this house is off of HWY 321.

The space
This house has three bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The master bedroom includes a king bed, ensuite, and 32" TV. It also has a patio door that leads out to the front porch so that you can sit and listen to the peaceful creek. On the other side of living room are two identical bedrooms with queen beds and 32 " TVs. In between the two bedrooms is the second full bathroom. The living room, dining room, and kitchen are all open concept. The living room has a gas log fireplace, a 55" TV, and a Blu - Ray Player. The couch in the living room is a sleeper sofa that could bring the accommodation of the house up to eight. The Kitchen is fully furnished and also has a full size washer and dryer for your use. Outside of the house it a 24" x 16" JUMBO Park Style Charcoal Grill if you would like to cookout will here. All TVs are hooked up to Spectrum Cable and there is high speed internet for you to use included in your stay.

The little things that make a big difference! The home is stocked with a starter supply of consumable items, including coffee filters, hand soap, paper towels, toilet paper, dishwasher soap, and garbage bags. Less planning for you, more enjoying your vacation!

We offer a 10% discount for those who stay 7 nights or more!

Other things to note
There are 5 steps to get onto the porch

listing_info.listing_name: Charming Cabin on a Creek
listing_info.description:
Welcome to Baskins Creek Retreat - a deluxe cabin with 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and perfect for a family of up to 8. This mountain cabin has a creek running right in the backyard and feels miles away from everything. But, you're less than 1 mile to the Gatlinburg strip on an easy access road. You can even bring the motorcycles! And just because you're in the mountains doesn't mean no modern amenities - Smart TVs and wifi are included.

The space
Less than 1 mile to the Gatlinburg Strip! Baskins Creek Retreat offers authentic log cabin accommodations and an incredible location right in town. Though it's in the mountains, you won't wear out the car to get there. This gem is fixed on a paved flat drive with room for two cars or a couple of motorcycles rarin' to ride the Smokies. If you can't bring the bikes cause you gotta bring the kids, Baskin's Creek is ready to take them too. With room for 8, this 3 bed, 2 bath cabin is spaced for privacy and togetherness. Fill the day by taking the little ones on a nature hike along the babbling creek in your backyard. Maybe you'll find the berries to bake a pie in your stainless steel, granite counter kitchen. Just 0.8 miles to Gatlinburg and 5 miles from Pigeon Forge your "to-do" options are endless. No matter the adventure you come for the first time, you'll leave with plans for the next. Book Baskins Creek Retreat and wake your wander!

Other things to note
Sits on a peaceful creek
Close to Gatlinburg

The space

The entry level of the cabin features the living room, kitchen, dining, 1 bedroom and a full bathroom.
The living room features comfortable leather couches, an electric fireplace and HDTV. The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and granite tops. The dining area offers seating for the whole group. The large windows brings in the beautiful views from all around.
The bedroom on this level features a king bed, high ceilings, HDTV and access to the full bathroom with double vanity and large, tiled walk-in shower.

Lower Level:
The lower level features the game room, 2 bedrooms, 1 shared bathroom, laundry and access to the deck with gas grill, seating and the hot tub.
As you come down the stairs, you enter into the game room. The game room offers an arcade game, air hockey, foosball and access to the deck.
The 1st bedroom on this level offers a queen bed, HDTV, access to the deck.
The 2nd bedroom offers a queen-over-queen bunk, HDTV, access to the deck and adjoining jack-'n-jill shared full bathroom. The shared bathroom offers a tub/shower.

Step out onto the deck, prepare a meal on the gas grill, relax in one the comfy chairs, or enjoy the soothing hot tub while taking in the views and sounds of nature.

Be sure to explore nearby attractions including Ober Gatlinburg, The Arts & Crafts Community in Gatlinburg, Anakeesta Gatlinburg, Dollywood, Splash Country, and The Island!
